decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the product feed to identify actual speakers, filtering out various accessories like cases and charging cables. My consideration set focused on highly-rated, waterproof portable speakers suitable for indoor and outdoor use. I chose the EDUPLINK Waterproof Portable Bluetooth Speaker because it offers the best balance of features (20W output, IPX7 rating, RGB lighting) and proven customer satisfaction, evidenced by over 9,000 reviews and a 4.5-star rating. Compared to the MusiBaby, which some reviewers noted wasn't loud enough, or the more expensive INSMY retro speaker, the EDUPLINK provides better overall value for a mid-range price.
